rcb_brush.py — task-local tooling for the RoboPaint BRUSH tasks (families kaishu, lettering, acrylic, oil), where the stroke itself

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Generate the frozen nimium broad-nib trajectory.
+
+Run normally to write /app/output/trajectory.npz on the scored sheet.  Pass
+--practice to replay the same marks on the unscored practice sheet and print a
+pixel comparison against the corresponding crop of the exemplar.
+"""
+import argparse
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+
+from rcb_brush import Session, quat_mul
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output/trajectory.npz")
+INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
+PX = 227.18 / 1024.0  # mm per pixel
+STEM_U = np.array([354.5, 383.3, 412.1, 440.9, 469.7, 498.5,
+                   527.3, 556.1, 585.0, 613.8, 642.5, 671.5])
+STEM_TOP, STEM_BOTTOM = 463.5, 560.5
+DOT_CENTERS = [(411.4356, 446.5111), (526.7920, 446.5044)]
+DOT_YAW = math.radians(31.0)
+DOT_LENGTH_M = 0.0024
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--practice", action="store_true")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+
+    s = Session(instance=INSTANCE, render=False)
+    p = s.primitives()
+    s.record_start()
+    y_shift = -0.1856 if args.practice else 0.0
+
+    # Load the dry steel nib, then do all orientation changes above the paper.
+    p["move_tip"]([-0.100, 0.150, 0.027], speed=0.06, settle=3)
+    p["move_tip"]([-0.100, 0.150, 0.060], speed=0.06, settle=2)
+
+    # The exemplar's twelve minims share one straight downstroke.  A 30 degree
+    # roll projects the four millimetre edge to the measured body width.
+    roll = math.radians(30.0)
+    qx = np.array([math.cos(roll / 2), math.sin(roll / 2), 0.0, 0.0])
+    q_stem = quat_mul(qx, s.tip_down_quat(0.0))
+
+    def xy(u, v):
+        x, y = s.geo.px_to_world(u, v)
+        return float(x), float(y + y_shift)
+
+    for i, u in enumerate(STEM_U):
+        x0, y0 = xy(u, STEM_TOP)
+        x1, y1 = xy(u, STEM_BOTTOM)
+        # Reorient and position in air; keep the pose fixed through contact.
+        p["move_tip"]([x0, y0, 0.030], quat_wxyz=q_stem, speed=0.08, settle=2)
+        p["move_tip"]([x0, y0, 0.0185], quat_wxyz=q_stem, speed=0.01, settle=2)
+        p["move_tip"]([x1, y1, 0.0185], quat_wxyz=q_stem, speed=0.015, settle=8)
+        p["move_tip"]([x1, y1, 0.040], quat_wxyz=q_stem, speed=0.03, settle=2)
+
+    # Each i dot is one short, diagonal broad-edge sweep.  Its 4 mm edge is at
+    # 31 degrees to the image row and the centre travels 2.4 mm normal to it.
+    q_dot = s.tip_down_quat(DOT_YAW)
+    norm = np.array([math.cos(DOT_YAW), math.sin(DOT_YAW)])
+    half = DOT_LENGTH_M / 2
+    for uc, vc in DOT_CENTERS:
+        # Screen normal (du,dv)=(cos(yaw), sin(yaw)); convert its endpoints
+        # through the sheet frame so pixel/world sign conventions stay explicit.
+        du = norm[0] * half / (s.geo.px_m)
+        dv = norm[1] * half / (s.geo.px_m)
+        xa, ya = xy(uc - du, vc - dv)
+        xb, yb = xy(uc + du, vc + dv)
+        p["move_tip"]([xa, ya, 0.030], quat_wxyz=q_dot, speed=0.08, settle=2)
+        p["move_tip"]([xa, ya, 0.0195], quat_wxyz=q_dot, speed=0.01, settle=2)
+        p["move_tip"]([xb, yb, 0.0195], quat_wxyz=q_dot, speed=0.008, settle=8)
+        p["move_tip"]([xb, yb, 0.040], quat_wxyz=q_dot, speed=0.03, settle=2)
+
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if not args.practice:
+        s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT, meta={"strokes": 14, "description": "nimium: twelve minims and two i dots"})
+
+    print("actions", actions.shape, "realized", len(s.strokes()),
+          "contacts", [(st["sheet"], st["inked"], round(st["length_mm"], 2)) for st in s.strokes()])
+    ink = s.ink("practice" if args.practice else "main") >= 0.5
+    if args.practice:
+        target = cv2.imread("/app/target.png", cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) < 128
+        expected = target[:, 288:736]
+        inter = int(np.count_nonzero(ink & expected))
+        union = int(np.count_nonzero(ink | expected))
+        print("practice raster", {"iou": inter / union, "precision": inter / max(1, int(ink.sum())),
+                                 "recall": inter / max(1, int(expected.sum())),
+                                 "pred_pixels": int(ink.sum()), "target_pixels": int(expected.sum())})
+        vis = np.full((1024, 448, 3), 245, np.uint8)
+        vis[expected] = (0, 255, 0)
+        vis[ink] = (0, 0, 0)
+        vis[expected & ink] = (0, 0, 255)
+        cv2.imwrite("/app/output/practice_overlay.png", cv2.resize(vis, (896, 2048), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST))
+    else:
+        print("saved", OUT, "steps", len(actions), "inked pixels", int(ink.sum()))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
